newsitem.title: UK: Cambridge Water to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge Water to buy back shares.

text.p: Britain's Cambridge Water Plc said on Wednesday it planned to buy back up to 10 percent of its shares by way of an off-market tender.
The water supplier company said it would use up to 4.0 million stg to buy back the shares.
Cambridge's shares closed at about 252.5p on Tuesday.
Payment for shares purchased will be made on January 28.
The company said it currently had no plans to diversify into non-water related businesses and was confident it would have enough resources to fund its core business.
Cambridge had net borrowings of about 9.2 million stg at September 30 and revenue reserves of about 16.7 million stg.
